summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container as specified, but nothing was run, so the new tests and the existing prepareQuery and DAWG update tests are unverified. Changes: Update class added to rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py now always returns an Update, with the prologue built from the first declaration group before the empty-request exit; evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added to processor.py and exported from the sparql package __init__; test/test_sparql_prepare.py added covering the required cases. Choices to review: group 0's prologue is translated twice on the non-empty path (idempotent), and no initBindings test was added. Open item: pprintAlgebra now prints the algebra list as-is for updates (debug helper only, left unchanged). No commits made.
